mapper.select: SELECT request_fingerprint, state, http_status, result_code, result_summary::text AS result_summary FROM app.request_dedup WHERE scope_key = #{context.scope} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{context.key} AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.request_dedup ( scope_key, user_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, state, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{context.scope}, #{context.userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{operation}, #{context.key}, #{fingerprint}, 'PROCESSING', clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL '1 day' ) ON CONFLICT (scope_key, operation, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET request_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.request_fingerprint, state = 'PROCESSING', http_status = NULL, result_code = NULL, result_summary = '{}', expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE app.request_dedup.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE app.request_dedup SET state = CASE WHEN #{code} = 'OK' THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END, http_status = #{status}, result_code = #{code}, result_type = 'ACCOUNT', result_summary = CAST(#{summary} AS JSONB), version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE scope_key = #{context.scope} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{context.key}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app.request_dedup WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM app.request_dedup WHERE expires_at < clock_timestamp() AND state != 'PROCESSING' LIMIT 100 )
